Asset type: transparent PNG animation sprite atlas for a side-on pixel-art battle game.
Primary request: Create ONE NEW ORIGINAL sprite atlas, portrait canvas approximately 1024 x 1536 pixels, exactly 3 equal columns by 4 equal rows. True transparent RGBA background with actual alpha=0 outside the sprites. No drawn checkerboard or solid background.
Subject and grid, reading left to right:
Row 1: original adult office wanderer IDLE; same wanderer WINDUP; same wanderer STRIKE.
Row 2: same wanderer GUARD; same wanderer HURT; same wanderer DEATH lying collapsed.
Row 3: original animated lavender filing-cabinet/office-stamp creature IDLE; same creature WINDUP; same creature STRIKE.
Row 4: same creature GUARD; same creature HURT; same creature DEATH collapsed.
Wanderer design: slouching adult with original asymmetrical black hair silhouette, rectangular black glasses, pale gray loose office shirt, loose olive trousers, dark shoes, holding a vivid red letter opener. Every pose faces RIGHT. Preserve the same design and proportions in all six frames.
Creature design: original surreal squat lavender filing cabinet combined with a chunky office stamp, simple black facial marks, flat cyan folded-paper arms, little black feet. Every pose faces LEFT. Preserve the same design and proportions in all six frames.
Style/medium: very chunky native pixel cartoon sprite art; bold opaque BLACK stepped outlines, square pixel clusters, approximately 64 logical pixels tall for an upright character, very limited flat color palette and only 2–3 hard shades per material. Enlarged nearest-neighbor pixel look. All colored regions opaque within silhouettes.
Composition: exactly ONE complete pose per cell, centered horizontally, with generous transparent padding from every cell edge. Keep upright poses at equal scale. Ground/foot baseline at about 86 percent down each row; each sprite including its weapon and strike motion remains entirely inside its own cell. Death frames rest on the same row ground baseline. No crossing between cells.
Constraints: original artwork inspired only by the broad deadpan suburban pixel-cartoon mood of Pronoun Palace, never copy its characters or screenshot assets. No backdrop, no grid lines, no cell borders, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no text, no interface, no logos.
